data.description:
Update .github/workflows/ci.yml llm-review job to implement narrow integration review scope for session→main PRs.

Changes required:
1. Add step to call verify-session-provenance.sh (from plugins/dso/scripts/) and capture unprovenanced-shas.txt artifact — set DSO_ARTIFACT_DIR to a temp dir, capture exit code (0=all provenanced, 1=some unprovenanced, 2=budget_exhausted)
2. Add step to compute cross-branch file set: enumerate session commits with DSO-Story-Merge trailers, group files changed per story-branch PR, emit files appearing in ≥2 groups to a temp file
3. Add step to union unprovenanced-shas diff + cross-branch files as the integration review diff input (replace current 'gh pr diff $PR_NUMBER | ci-llm-review-runner.sh' with scoped diff piped to runner)
4. DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE computation: current ci.yml logic (counting finding-1 headers across issue comments + review-thread comments) is correct for session→main PRs — verify it applies unchanged
5. DSO_CI_REVIEW_PRIOR_DEFENSES_PATH: when REVIEW_CYCLE>=2 point to prior cycle findings so TrackerDefenseStore defenses are suppressed
6. Empty scope guard: when both unprovenanced set and cross-branch file set are empty, skip Run LLM review step and exit 0 cleanly (use 'if: steps.<step-id>.outputs.scope_nonempty == true' or equivalent GITHUB_ENV flag)

All changes must make the tests from Task 1 (5fc9-9844-9278-417a) pass.

Testing mode: GREEN
data.title: GREEN: Implement narrow integration review scope in ci.yml llm-review job
